$schema.description: The path to the JSON schema file for validation.

ClientId.description: The unique identifier or name for the client.

ServerAddress.description: The address of the backup server to connect to.

EncryptionKey.description: The path to the AES-GCM encryption key file used for encrypting and authenticating backup data.

Jobs.description: The list of backup jobs to be handled by the client.

JobId.description: The unique identifier for the backup job.

BasePath.description: The base path for the backup job. All file patterns will be relative to this path. This directory will be locked during restore operations.

FilePatterns.description: A list of glob patterns to include in the backup.

Interval.description: The interval at which the backup job should run.

Unit.description: The unit of time for the interval.

Value.description: The value of the interval in the specified unit.

ChunkSize.description: The size of each chunk for the backup.

MinKB.description: The minimum chunk size in kilobytes.

MaxKB.description: The maximum chunk size in kilobytes.

ExpiryPolicy.description: The policy for expiring old snapshots.

MaxAge.description: The maximum age for backups before they are considered expired.

Unit.description: The unit of time for the maximum age.

Value.description: The value of the maximum age in the specified unit.

MaxCount.description: The maximum number of backups to retain.
